title: Handling Charge by Reconditioning Labor — PAP Therapy Equipment Refunds
content:
# Handling Charge by Reconditioning Labor — PAP Therapy Equipment Refunds

**Prerequisite.** Before the refund's handling charge is applied, the return inspection on the device record must show the reconditioning labor units booked for the unit. Equivalently, no handling charge is applied to the refund while the device record shows no return inspection with the labor units booked.

**Charges schedule.** The handling charge deducted from the refund of a self-pay PAP Therapy Equipment unit follows the reconditioning labor on the return inspection:

| Labor units booked on the return inspection | Handling charge (USD) |
|---|---|
| 10 or more | 35.00 |
| 5 to 9 | 20.00 |
| fewer than 5 | 0.00 |

Labor units are 15-minute units. The return inspection is the inspection job in the device's service history that carries no repair cost assignment; the labor units are the units booked on that job.

## Both sides of each line

| Units booked | Charge |
|---|---|
| 4 | 0.00 |
| 5 | 20.00 |
| 9 | 20.00 |
| 10 | 35.00 |

**Case (hypothetical).** An inspection booking 7 labor units: a handling charge of 20.00 is deducted from the refund.
